resolved_findings: Do not interpret partial no-server output as a completed observation.
Drain and terminate owned probe children even when the parent exits nonzero.
Keep status deadlines out of the legacy reparent tmux preflight.
Treat inaccessible tmux sockets as unavailable, not absent.
Skip unused worktree inventory for scoped checkout reports.
Reject joined cancellation, deadline, and drain failures before classifying exit code one as a missing ref.

runner_limit_note: The first candidate's full CLI suite exceeded Go's default 10-minute package limit; the active test passed alone. Full runs use a 30-minute test-runner limit, not a change to the product's 5-second per-process and 30-second invocation budgets.
platform_note: No Windows support is introduced. The unchanged baseline Windows build fails because the registry/spaces flock helpers are Unix-only.
